items.title: Public comment at Commission on Immigrant Rights and Citizenship meeting
items.summary: Residents can speak for up to three minutes during public comment at the hybrid meeting, in person or by raising a hand on Zoom after registering. Topics include ShotSpotter, family preparedness, FY27 planning, and SNAP and MassHealth support.
